title: Normalized affine presentation of a section algebra
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ a presheaf of sets on schemes over $S$, $T$ a scheme over $S$, $f:F\to h_T$ a map and $L$ a cartesian test-line family [def-trf-cartesian-line-presentation]. A section-Proj model consists of a normalized section algebra $A$ [lem-trf-space-section-algebra-etale-base-change], affine graded algebra data $C$ [def-nagata-relative-proj], and linear equivalences $\Gamma(V,A_n)\simeq C(V)_n$ on every affine base open. These equivalences preserve homogeneous products, the base-ring unit and all affine restrictions. Its graded line map [def-trf-space-line-module-proj-input] evaluates every homogeneous element corresponding to $s$ as $A$ evaluates $s$ on every scheme test over its domain. This is the existing SectionProjModel structure moved verbatim out of the parent module; it adds no geometric hypothesis.
